observations: A future-only versioned evaluator path can remove instruction-scorer vocabulary drift without changing the default legacy protocol or historical evidence.
Sharing one typed public contract between generation and scoring makes required concepts inspectable while keeping expected answers, seed, nonce, and scorer-only data sealed.
Structural concept coverage is intentionally narrower than semantic action correctness and must not be reported as a capability result.

changes: Added an opt-in typed PublicConceptContract whose executor-visible identifiers, entry shape, and instruction are derived from the same representation used by the sealed evaluator.
Added a deterministic structural v2 evaluator that requires the exact answer field, exact ordered concept identifiers, one entry per identifier, and a nonempty action for each entry.
Kept heldout-v1 as the default and retained the legacy substring evaluator and reference-agent behavior for compatibility.
Deep-copied the public executor view so child-side mutation cannot alter the sealed scoring object.
Added positive and fail-closed regressions for missing, duplicate, malformed, empty-action, and substring-only answers, plus public/sealed mismatch rejection.
